data.one_liner: An opinionated set of high-quality, robust, and up-to-date lint rules used at LeanCode.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of custom lint rules and an analyzer plugin for Dart and Flutter. It enforces code conventions, helps avoid common anti-patterns like using BuildContext in Blocs, and catches structural code issues.
use_when: You want to enforce strict, high-quality code style and architecture rules in your Flutter projects.
You want custom lint checks tailored towards Bloc-based state management.
You want to catch potential bugs and stale UI reads during static analysis.
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter and Dart lints without strict opinionated additions.
Your project does not use state management patterns or architectures covered by LeanCode's rules.
strengths: Includes helpful custom lints and quick fixes for common architectural mistakes.
Supports custom configuration via a dedicated plugin package.
Actively maintained with regular updates for newer Dart and analyzer versions.
weaknesses: Strict opinionated rules may require significant refactoring on existing legacy codebases.
Requires proper setup of analyzer plugins in analysis_options.yaml.
data.setup_notes: Add leancode_lint as a dev dependency, include its analysis_options.yaml in your project's configuration, and enable the analyzer plugin.
